thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Praça Mauá / Museum of Tomorrow / MAR — adjacent.
Christ the Redeemer / Sugarloaf — allow queues + traffic buffer.
Copacabana — longer transfer; not ideal on a short call.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Praça Mauá museums + waterfront + 75 min buffer.
thingsToDo.standardCall: One iconic viewpoint (Christ or Sugarloaf) + downtown + 90–120 min buffer for traffic.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Beach + viewpoint only with early start and confirmed all-aboard.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Plan traffic buffers for anything beyond Praça Mauá; Rio road times vary widely.
